paraphrase: Acceptable: showing your own apps for purchase or promotion, as long as the app is not merely a catalog of them; curated collections of third-party apps for a specific approved need with robust editorial content; disabling approved rental content (films, TV, music, books) after the rental period, while all other items and services may never expire; Wallet passes for payments, offers or identification only; insurance apps that are free, legally compliant where distributed and do not use in-app purchase; approved nonprofits fundraising with Apple Pay support, disclosure of how funds are used, legal compliance and tax receipts, with nonprofit platforms listing only approved nonprofits; person-to-person monetary gifts without in-app purchase if the gift is fully optional and 100% goes to the recipient, but any gift connected to digital content or services must use in-app purchase; financial trading, investing or money management apps should be submitted by the institution providing the service and must hold the necessary licences where offered.
